fusions.name: Reeling Gaff
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed hook of arcana at an enemy up to 7 tiles away that deals 24 damage, rising to 1.3 times at full range. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Snagging Rift
fusions.desc: Opens a snagging rift of arcana 5 tiles long ahead of you for 4 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward, dealing 10 damage and stunning them for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Cast the Line
fusions.desc: Hooks up to 4 enemies within 7 tiles with lines of arcana and pulls them onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbed Attention
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 10% more damage.
